claims.summary: For M >= 2, 1 <= k <= M-1, p = M-k, at the regular M-gon centred at 0: raising the top k columns of the cherry window Lambda_p by a partition lambda with at most k parts and lambda_1 <= p gives a nonzero least coefficient if and only if lambda = ((p-1)^k), of weight k(M-k-1).
claims.assessment: Working proof (eliminators z^i - (z^i mod P) = g_i P, complete homogeneous h_j = [M | j] at the polygon, Jacobi minor of Pi with only diagonal and p_M entries: permutation for C = {p..M-1}, two rows on one column otherwise); numerical checks at the pentagon and heptagon, including lambda_1 > p (research/results/bmd-20261009-key/raised-tops.txt); reviewed by one fresh-context medium reviewer.
claims.rationale: Gives, at every regular polygon in the residual Omega_k, a raised coordinate with nonzero least coefficient, without the multi-column expansion.
claims.next_action: Arc analysis at a polygon: compare the rectangle raise's valuation with the window and single shifts along arcs ending at the polygon.
